verdicts.reason: Ordinary jobs bypass the branch routes, and a heavy building completes on untreated marsh with no refusal or stilts.
Hauling uses the bole-anchored routes. Marsh refuses heavy construction until stilts are finished. Raiders and colonists move on and off the crown both ways with no gates.
The mud slows everyone equally regardless of weight, and there is neither self-release nor companion-assisted escape.
Sinking scales with weight and the hold causes no injury. Both self-release and companion extraction work.
The gallery destroys an adjacent colony wall, a building and a boughway, all of which must stay intact.
The large-pool encounter is limited to the great pool. The contract sets no pool-size reach requirement, and reach is a provisional engineering value.
A tamed victim gets a deadline, nearby help rescues it and earns the reward, and distant help remains uncertain.
The real water strike kills immediately and no rescue deadline is created.
The grievance spreads to every pool and stops all porter service, and it is lost on reload.
The list is obtainable through normal stock, gives a dated snapshot, and reading it leaves danger unchanged.
An ambient whole-body emergence occurs as a random event, which must stay excluded.
Disabling the feature in transit consumes the treatment instead of returning it.
Teaching happens on a failed placement, and a fatal hit deletes the captive with no occupant outcome.
The young establishes at its own pool over several days, and the correct poison at that pool stops it.
Reload forgives the owed gift and resets the pressure, and a repeated display release pays twice.
The bait is created by normal work, raiders converge on it, and a delayed second front comes from a separate edge.
With RM_Thirst active, the native drinks home water through a normal thirst job without dehydrating.
The harvest yields real goods. Ignition flashes the eligible haze and wakes eligible water, while the defeated adult's pool stays quiet.
Eye eligibility is limited to the great pool. The contract imposes no pool-size reach scaling, and reach is a provisional value.
Carrying the victim never clears the active deadline, and the rescued colonist is lost anyway.
A global flag stops porters at both pools, and danger at pool A is unchanged apart from the overlay.
Bird calls resume while the sentinel hush is still active; the hush must silence both the bed and the calls.
The defeated adult still strikes through the shared shore exposure even though the limbs are quiet.
Poison at the wrong pool prevents maturity; only the right poison at the young's own pool may do so.
The display release pays goodwill and the enhanced gift twice when it must pay only once.
The second front enters beside the first instead of from a separated approach.
Teaching occurs on failed placement; only placed production may teach.
The flash wakes water whose adult was permanently defeated, which violates adult quiet.
